lines.zh: 步履沉重，金属靴声响彻山谷。
lines.en: Heavy steps, metallic boots resound in the valley.
Muscles tremble beneath the iron armor.

lines.zh: 呼吸声沉重，如铁锤撞击。
步态沉重，每一步都踏在恐惧上。
lines.en: Gait heavy, each step on fear.

lines.zh: 铁甲摩擦，发出沉闷的声响。
lines.en: Iron armor rubs, making a dull noise.

lines.zh: 沉重的脚步声，震得地面颤抖。
步履蹒跚，仿佛每一步都在挣扎。
lines.en: Painful steps, struggling with each one.

lines.zh: 铁甲摩擦，金属摩擦声刺耳。
沉重的脚步声，令人不安。
我沿着伊甸的草坡慢慢走。
lines.en: I wander the grassy slopes of Eden.
My hooves press the glowing grass.

lines.zh: 静静地站立，目光锐利如刀。
lines.en: Stand still, eyes sharp as knives.

lines.zh: 肌肉紧绷，随时准备战斗。
耐心等待，只待一击制胜。
lines.en: Patiently waiting, for the decisive strike.

lines.zh: 铁甲反射阳光，闪烁着光芒。
lines.en: Iron armor glints under the sun.

lines.zh: 沉默中透露出不祥的气息。
凝视远方，等待目标出现。
lines.en: Scanning the distance, waiting for a target.

lines.zh: 警惕地四处张望，寻找威胁。
lines.en: Skanng the surroundings, looking for threats.

lines.zh: 沉思般站立，似乎在等待什么。
lines.en: Standing in thought, waiting for something.
Iron armor gleams under the sun.
Eyes like knives, staring at the player.

lines.zh: 目光锐利，锁定玩家位置。
lines.en: Sharp eyes, locking onto the player.
Staring at the player, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 目光闪烁，寻找玩家踪迹。
lines.en: Eyes flickering, searching for the player.

lines.zh: 警惕地注视玩家，随时攻击。
lines.en: Cautiously watching the player, ready to attack.
Iron armor gleams, locking onto the player.

lines.zh: 目光如炬，玩家如在火中。
lines.en: Eyes like flames, player in the fire.
Eyes like lightning, locking on the player.
Fierce eyes, staring at the player.
Green fluid seeps from the wound.

lines.zh: 身体开始变暗，失去光泽。
你一剑刺中了它的要害。

lines.en: You burned it with a torch.
You fell from a great height.
You stayed in the water too long.

lines.zh: 你手里的半熟肉在滴油。
lines.en: The half-cooked meat in your hand drips fat.
Some half-cooked meat, care to try?
Don’t provoke me, you’ll rue it!
One bump and my gold is gone.

lines.zh: 伊甸的草地被我踩出脚印。
lines.en: My footprints dent the Eden grass.
Eden's grass — who lowers their head first?

lines.zh: 这里藏有财富，小心为上。

lines.en: Be cautious, or you'll lose it.

lines.zh: 伊甸之魂，守护者的灵魂。
伊甸之魂，金锭紧随其后。

lines.en: I lower my head and aim my horns.

lines.zh: 敌人的脚步声，即将降临。

lines.en: You struck first, so don't blame me.

lines.zh: 我本不想理你，现在不同了。
lines.en: I meant to ignore you; that has changed.

lines.zh: 伊甸的草被我踩得一响。
lines.en: The grass of Eden snaps under my feet.

lines.zh: 你的剑还滴着血，我看见了。
lines.en: Your blade still drips; I saw it.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声停在伊甸草地。
lines.en: Your steps stop on Eden's grass.

lines.zh: 我绕着你走，蹄子不出声。
瞄准玩家，攻击即将开始。

lines.en: I lower my horns and close in slowly.

lines.zh: 我压低前半身，准备顶过去。
lines.en: I lower my forequarters, ready to charge.
An Eden guardian does not back down.

lines.zh: 你退到坡下，就没地利了。
lines.en: Fall back down the slope and you lose the ground.
I count the gaps in your guard.
This horn is longer than your sword.

lines.zh: 伊甸的草丛太矮，藏不住你。
lines.en: Eden's grass is too short to hide you.

lines.zh: 草叶在抖，是我的脚在使劲。
lines.en: The grass shivers — my feet are digging in.
I'm in no hurry; you go first.
Drawing blood in Eden has a price.

lines.zh: 你一抬手，我就知道要砍哪。
lines.en: The moment you raise your arm, I know where you'll swing.
Rip through your armor with claws!
Your strength is not enough to hit me!

lines.zh: 我的角从你盾牌下挑进去。
lines.en: My horn hooks under your shield.
Flesh torn from you, belongs to me!
I'd share Eden's fruit — too late.
My horn tip rips your chestplate open!
My forehoof slams down and the ground gives!

lines.zh: 这一下是还你的第一刀！
lines.en: This pays back your first cut!
I batter your shield aside and come again!
A broadside gore — you can't dodge it!

lines.zh: 让你记住伊甸的草不好踩！
lines.en: Remember: Eden's grass is not yours to trample!

lines.zh: 我的肩膀比你的膝盖硬！
lines.en: My shoulder is harder than your knee!
Roll down the slope and don't come back!
The gold is mine, and so is your life!

lines.zh: 你砍我一刀，我还你三下！
lines.en: One cut from you earns three from me!

lines.zh: 我的利爪要破灭你的梦想！
lines.en: My claws will shatter your dreams!
This is Eden's soil — you don't get to tread it.
I am the guardian of Eden!

lines.zh: 伊甸的草地轻轻起伏，我站了起来。
lines.en: The grass of Eden stirs and I rise.

lines.zh: 我睁开眼，光从头顶洒下。
lines.en: I open my eyes as light spills down from above.
It fell from a great height.
It stayed in the water too long.

lines.zh: 你的一枚炸弹炸伤了它。
你的箭矢射中了它的身体。

lines.en: Its body was hit by magic.
It is too hungry and weak.
